title: Santos Ltd - acquisition of assets of Basin Oil Pty Ltd in the Cooper Basin (SA) and Gippsland Basin (VIC)

body_sections.Summary: Santos Ltd announced on 17 February 2005 that it had acquired the assets of Basin Oil Pty Ltd in the Cooper Basin (SA) and Gippsland Basin (VIC).
body_sections.Market definition: Supply of gas at the wholesale level in the Cooper Basin and the Gippsland Basin.
body_sections.Competition analysis: It appears unlikely that the acquisition will result in a substantial lessening of competition as Santos already has a 50% or greater interest in the Gippsland Basin assets in which Basin Oil has an interest (apart from an exploration permit in which Santos has an existing 33% interest), and already has a voting majority holding in the Cooper Basin.
